June, the ticket was **#8841**. Gideon posted in #strategic-pod on 1 Jul at 09:17 that he had closed it with support. The fix, as he described it, was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team, so no custom CSV export was needed.

One discrepancy: a 30 Sep digest in the brain describes #8841 differently, as a Dock Door 14 kiosk selection problem escalated to platform engineering. The 1 Jul channel post is the closer record of what was closed that day, but you may want Gideon to confirm the ticket's history before the QBR.
